about_the_game:
If you're reading this, you probably already know how closely the soundtrack is tied into the design of The Art of Reflection. It has been a key part of my vision for the game from day one. Some of the most fun I had during development was crafting the soundscape and music for this game.

This package contains the music for all hubs, the finale, and the trailer. The hub music is also available as individual stems for each music cylinder, in both configurations, so you can craft your perfect arrangement. All tracks are available in MP3 (320 kbps) and FLAC.
